about.title: About TamreenLab
about.description: TamreenLab is a site for learning Excel by doing, right in your browser.
about.body:
TamreenLab teaches Excel through practice: instead of watching a long video, you work through short steps in a real worksheet in your browser and find out straight away whether your answer is right.

The lessons are made for students, new employees and anyone preparing for a job test. They start with cells and ranges and go up to functions such as SUMIF and VLOOKUP, and they work on computers and phones. You can learn in Arabic, English or French.

The exercises are free and need no account. An account is optional: it saves your progress and points and puts you on the leaderboard.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.draft: Draft: this page needs a legal review before launch.
privacy.body:
We collect as little data as possible.

If you practise without an account, your progress is stored only in your browser. If you create an account, we store your email, your display name and your password, hashed so it cannot be reversed, together with your answers and points so we can show your progress and the leaderboard.

We record anonymous usage statistics, such as starting or finishing a lesson, with a random identifier that is not linked to your name or email, to improve the lessons. You can turn them off in the consent banner.

Ads may be shown on explanation pages. Personalised ads are only allowed with your consent.

You can delete your account and all its data at any time from the bottom of this page once signed in, or write to us through the contact page.

terms.title: Terms of use
terms.description: Terms of use of the TamreenLab website.
terms.draft: Draft: this page needs a legal review before launch.
terms.body:
By using TamreenLab you agree to use it for personal learning and in a way that does not harm the site or other users.

The lessons, examples and data are our own work and may not be copied or published without permission.

The display name you choose is shown publicly on the leaderboard, so do not use a name that is offensive or belongs to someone else. We may edit or remove any name that breaks this rule.

We provide the site as it is. We aim for accurate content but cannot guarantee it is free of errors.

contact.title: Contact us
contact.description: For questions, suggestions and reporting a mistake in a lesson.
contact.body:
We'd love to hear what you think of the lessons, a topic you'd like to see, or a mistake in a step or explanation.

The contact address will be added at launch.

consent.label: Privacy choices
consent.text: We use anonymous statistics to improve the lessons, and we may show ads. Choose what suits you; details are in the <link>privacy policy</link>.
